subject: Pricing, PO format, and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@everstride.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@everstride.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing, PO format, and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week — team was impressed with the latency profiles. Procurement asked me to follow up with a few requirements so we can get a PO raised quickly and unblock implementation: 

- PO format: EverStride requires a PO with line-item breakdown by environment (prod / staging / dev), and an explicit contract term (start + months). We attached our PO template (Everstride_PO_Template.pdf) — can you confirm Redwood can accept that layout?
- Net terms: Standard ask is net 60; can you confirm Redwood's flexibility here?
- Invoice cadence: Our finance team prefers consolidated monthly invoices (one invoice per calendar month) with PO number on each invoice. They will not accept weekly invoices.
- Pricing/discount: EverStride expects a committed-discount schedule if we commit to 12 or 24 months. Can you propose committed pricing tiers and any minimum spend thresholds?
- Documentation: Please include a current SOW and a W-9 so procurement can attach to the PO.

We need to present this to our CFO on Friday 31-Jul to stay on the onboarding timeline. If you can confirm terms and share the docs today/tomorrow that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
EverStride Health

Attachments: Everstride_PO_Template.pdf
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@everstride.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing, PO format, and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the timeline; we'll prioritize this. Answers below and next steps.

1) PO format: We can accept your PO layout with a couple caveats — the invoice needs to include our tax ID and billing address (I attached Redwood_PO_Template.pdf for your reference). Line items can map to prod/staging/dev as requested.

2) Net terms: Our standard is net 30. For strategic / enterprise customers we can provisionally extend to net 45 for the first 90 days while onboarding completes; net 60 is uncommon but we can consider it as an escalation with finance approval.

3) Invoice cadence: Monthly consolidated invoices per calendar month is fine — that aligns with our billing system. Please confirm you want consolidated invoices (one invoice per month) vs per-environment invoices; both are possible but consolidated is easier for reconciliation.

4) Pricing/discounts: Proposed committed tiers — 12-month commit: 12% discount off list; 24-month commit: 15% discount. We can also offer a ramp credit for the first full quarter (one-time consumption credit) if you sign within July. If there are minimum spend thresholds for EverStride, share them and we'll map to an MRR equivalent.

5) Docs: Attached is a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_v1.docx). I'll loop in Neha (finance) and Rishi (account exec) to finalize net terms and get PO intake instructions to your team.

Next steps:
- If these terms look acceptable, please send the filled PO (your template) with PO number and the signed SOW.
- We'll ingest the PO and create the invoice schedule; DocuSign link for SOW signature to follow.

On the net terms exception, I've copied Neha so she can expedite the review. If you need us to accept net 60 as a one-off, please confirm the business justification so we can escalate to Finance leadership.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.pdf, Redwood_SOW_v1.docx
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pricing, PO format, and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Lauren / Rishi — quick internal note on flexibility:

- Finance can approve net 45 on a case-by-case basis for enterprise deals with a signed PO and a minimum 12-month commitment. For net 60 we need VP-Finance sign-off and a credit check.
- Monthly consolidated invoices are fine; we require the PO number on each invoice and our AP system needs invoice line items to include charge category codes (we'll send the mapping file if they want the full breakdown).
- Discounts: negotiated committed discounts are supported via the deal record (deal id EVR-2026-1487). For the 12% / 15% tiers Lauren proposed, we need the finance-approved rate sheet attached to the quote to avoid downstream re-pricing.

I'll stand by to approve net45 if Lauren confirms the 12-month commitment in the quote. Priyom — note potential legal flags: verify SOW indemnity paragraph 4.2 aligns with our template.

-Neha
Head of Sales Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@everstride.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@everstride.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing, PO format, and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Lauren — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping in Finance. We reviewed internally and can move forward with the following: 

- Commitment: EverStride will sign a 12-month commitment at the 12% discounted tier.
- Net terms: We can accept net 45 for the first 90 days while onboarding is in progress. After that invoices will move to net 60 aligned to our AP policy (we'll flag this on the PO). Please note: our CFO prefers net 60 long-term but will accept net45 for launch.
- Invoice cadence: We will provide a consolidated monthly PO number and request one invoice per calendar month. Each invoice should include separate line items for prod/staging/dev and reference the PO number.
- Docs: Attached is a filled PO using our template (see attached). Please prepare the final SOW for signature — we'll execute via DocuSign once we receive the link.

We'll attach the PO to the HubSpot deal and send the PO PDF to your billing mailbox after you confirm the final SOW changes.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
EverStride Health

Attachments: Everstride_PO_Template.pdf (filled)
